key_findings.GB1: historical_50_50 beat random at micro_8; V2 degraded at micro_8 and tied historical at micro_16
key_findings.TRPB: historical_50_50 and V2 both beat random at micro_8 and tied each other at both cadences
key_findings.PHOQ: random micro_8 exceeded both active controllers; V2 modestly improved over historical at micro_16 but did not resolve the landscape failure
key_findings.generalization: active acquisition gains reproduced on GB1 and TRPB but not PHOQ; no universal controller superiority established

gate_decision: 2B candidate assembly may begin as a separate assembly stage, carrying acquisition instability as an explicit limitation. Do not treat 2A controller behavior as universally solved before 2C.
